init.title: Options
init.description: How long the cheapest and dearest windows are, the energy meters your bill is worked out from, and your battery. A meter is a sensor in kWh that only ever rises, such as your smart meter's import and export totals. Leave them empty to show prices only. The savings need the whole home's use, and a battery needs its charge and size.

data.house_energy_entity: Energy used by the whole home
data.battery_discharge_energy_entity: Energy taken out of the battery

data_description.import_energy_entity: Needed for the bill. Read every minute.
data_description.house_energy_entity: Needed for the savings. A meter of all the energy the home used, from the grid, solar and battery.
data_description.battery_discharge_energy_entity: Optional. Takes battery wear off the savings.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: Optional. With the battery size, values the energy the battery holds.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Optional. Usable size of the battery.
data_description.battery_wear_per_kwh: Optional. What each kWh taken out of the battery costs in wear, in the tariff's currency.

find_window.name: Find window
find_window.description: Finds the cheapest or dearest stretch of a given length in the next two days of prices, and what it would cost for a load of a given power.

flow.name: Direction
flow.description: Import prices what you pay, export what you are paid.

highest.name: Dearest
highest.description: Find the dearest window instead of the cheapest.

power_kw.name: Power
power_kw.description: The load in kilowatts. The cost is for a load of this size.

earliest_start.name: Earliest start
earliest_start.description: The window may not start before this. Defaults to now.

latest_end.name: Latest end
latest_end.description: The window must finish by this time.

get_prices.name: Get prices
get_prices.description: Returns the import and export price of every stretch of time in a range, from yesterday to the end of tomorrow.

start.name: Start
start.description: The first moment wanted. Defaults to now.

end.name: End
end.description: The end of the range. Defaults to 24 hours after the start.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.
